text.tspan: Apply failed halfway: repair state, read the plan, then fix forward or revert
succeeded, in state: nothing to do
is tainted, so must be replaced
failed mid-create: let it replace, or untaint if verified OK
+ create, but it exists in AWS
orphan (crash before state write): import it
remaining work: next apply does it
Terraform isn't transactional but saves each success to state. Never restore an old state file to "roll back": it changes Terraform's
memory, not AWS. Full roll-forward procedure + what can't be undone: interview-prep/terraform/08-rollback.md.
Prevent: quotas checked, apply role tested in staging, small MRs and states, keep errored.tfstate as a CI artifact.
